AL.title: Alabama Bingo: Finding a Charity Game Near You | FindBingo.org
AL.description: Alabama allows charity bingo only where a local amendment permits it. How to find a game where you live, who to ask, and how halls can list games free.
AL.welcome: Looking for a game in Alabama? Bingo is legal here only where voters approved a local amendment, and only for charity, so it depends on where you live. The county sheriff’s office or county commission can tell you what is allowed nearby.

AK.welcome: Looking for bingo in Alaska? Charity games here run under state permits, and the Department of Revenue’s permit search, linked below, shows which groups hold one. Call a permit holder near you to ask when they play, then send us the days so the next player can find them.
